about: The element a person presses, and the square that holds one glyph.

disabled.about: A disabled button keeps its box in every look and stops taking a press.
disabled.title: Disabled

effects.about: The candy a page can ask for: a glow round the box. The ripple that spreads from a press is on every button.
effects.title: Effects

elevation.about: A lifted button rises under a pointer and drops towards the page under a press.
elevation.title: Elevation

looks.about: Every look the vocabulary offers, and the `glass` layer style the button adds beside them, crossed with every size. A look reads the palette rather than a colour, so a status or a theme moves all of them at once.
looks.title: Looks and sizes

pressed.about: A button that stays pressed states `aria-pressed`, and the recipe fills it while it is on. That is what a toggle is here.
pressed.title: Pressed

square.about: A button holding one glyph fixes the square shape and requires an accessible name, because the glyph names nothing.
square.title: One glyph

statuses.about: A status points the palette at the semantic palette of its name and sets nothing else, so the look decides how that palette is drawn.
statuses.title: Statuses

title: Button
